description: This file defines the class IDBBatchAtomicVFS, a virtual file system implementation that uses IndexedDB for storage, supporting batch atomic writes, versioned data, and file locking mechanisms. It includes methods for opening, closing, reading, writing, truncating, syncing, and managing database files with version control and purging capabilities.

classes.name: IDBBatchAtomicVFS
classes.description: A virtual file system class implementing batch atomic versioned writes using IndexedDB, supporting file locking, purging, and dynamic reblocking for page size changes.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the IDBBatchAtomicVFS with database name and options, setting up IndexedDB context.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the associated IndexedDB database.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all open files and the IndexedDB connection.

methods.name: xOpen
methods.description: Opens a file, creating it if necessary, and reads its metadata block.

methods.name: xClose
methods.description: Closes a file and deletes it if flagged for deletion.

methods.name: xRead
methods.description: Reads data from a file at a specified offset, handling block fetching and buffer growth.

methods.name: xWrite
methods.description: Writes data to a file at a specified offset, batching writes and handling asynchronous operation timing.

methods.name: #xWriteHelper
methods.description: Helper method to perform the actual write operation, updating file size and metadata.

methods.name: xTruncate
methods.description: Truncates a file to a specified size, deleting excess blocks.

methods.name: xSync
methods.description: Synchronizes file metadata and data to IndexedDB, considering durability options.

methods.name: #xSyncHelper
methods.description: Helper method to perform sync, updating block 0 if metadata changed.

methods.name: xFileSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a file.

methods.name: xLock
methods.description: Acquires a lock on a file, updating block 0 if shared lock is obtained.

methods.name: xUnlock
methods.description: Releases a lock on a file.

methods.name: xCheckReservedLock
methods.description: Checks if a reserved lock exists on a file.

methods.name: xSectorSize
methods.description: Returns the sector size (512 bytes).

methods.name: xDeviceCharacteristics
methods.description: Returns device capabilities flags.

methods.name: xFileControl
methods.description: Performs control operations like overwrite, sync, begin/commit/rollback atomic write, handling versioning and purging.

methods.name: xAccess
methods.description: Checks if a file exists.

methods.name: xDelete
methods.description: Deletes a file from IndexedDB.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Removes obsolete blocks for a file, used for cleanup.

methods.name: #maybePurge
methods.description: Schedules a purge operation if conditions are met.

methods.name: #bound
methods.description: Creates a key range for IndexedDB queries based on file and version.

methods.name: #reblockIfNeeded
methods.description: Reblocks a file if page size has changed, converting data accordingly.
